summary: Iter 178 verified the Stripe Connect vendor payments + admin platform-fees marketplace layer AND the two iter177 regression fixes (web /games/wheel routing + mobile sponsor wheel config). Advisor booking backwards-compat: /api/social/dreams/bookings/checkout with a service on an un-onboarded advisor still returns a Stripe checkout_url (200) — no gating when require_payout_onboarding=false. WEB UI 100% PASS: /payouts renders payouts-page + payout-card-merchant showing 'Karak Cafe — Karama Branch', fee 5%, currency AED, agreement checkbox gates the connect button (disabled true→false after check); merchant portal sidebar exposes 'Payments & Payouts' link. /admin/platform-fees renders admin-platform-fees + fee-default-input(=15) + merchant 5% row + fee-require-onboarding + fee-save-btn; changed default 15→14, reloaded, persisted to 14, then RESET to 15. REGRESSION FIXED (web): /play-and-win sponsor-discover-play-wheel_spn_02564c15d4 now navigates to /games/wheel?game_id=wheel_spn_02564c15d4 (was /games/spin) and the wheel renders 'Sponsored by Karak Cafe' with 500pts top prize. REGRESSION FIXED (mobile): sponsor-discover-card-wheel_spn_02564c15d4 in games tab navigates to /games/wheel?game_id=... and correctly renders Karak Cafe sponsor + 500pts + 50pts + Try again slices (NOT the old house wheel). Sponsor Game Builder: analytics button (sponsor-game-analytics-<id>) opens sponsor-analytics-modal with sponsor-analytics-stats + sponsor-analytics-distribution; edit form has sponsor-preview-toggle → sponsor-preview-panel + sponsor-preview-wheel (with a Spinning… animation triggered via sponsor-preview-spin). sponsor-preview-scratch only appears when game_type=scratch (correct). Cleanup done: platform fees reset to default 15%+merchant 5% require_payout_onboarding OFF at test-module teardown AND after UI edit.

react_native_issues.issue: React warning: 'Invalid DOM property transform-origin. Did you mean transformOrigin?' still fires on the mobile /games/wheel screen (pre-existing since iter177). Non-blocking but should be renamed to transformOrigin in the wheel SVG. Reference: /app/mobile/app/games/wheel.tsx (or equivalent).

action_items: OPTIONAL (mobile, cosmetic): fix `transform-origin` → `transformOrigin` React warning on /games/wheel screen.
PRD: consider gating /admin/vendor-accounts list with pagination + filters (currently returns 200 items). Not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/vendor_payments.py: agreement is only stored on FIRST /onboard call (when the vendor_account doc is inserted); subsequent /onboard calls do NOT re-persist agreement, IP, or fee_bps_at_accept even if the caller re-checks the checkbox. That's actually correct (agreement is a one-time consent) — but note that if the global default fee changes AFTER the vendor onboards, the stored fee_bps_at_accept stays at the historical value. The account's live fee_bps is also frozen at creation. If admin later lowers the fee, existing vendors won't benefit unless there's a migration job.
routes/vendor_payments.py:_eligible_vendor filter for merchant uses `{owner_user_id: uid} OR {owner_user_ids: uid}` — good OR fallback for legacy multi-owner docs.

routes/vendor_payments.py: `require_payout_onboarding` config flag exists but is only surfaced via get_fee_config; make sure any checkout that DOES consult vendor_ready() actually falls back gracefully to a platform charge when the flag is off (booking regression test confirms current behaviour is correct).
PayoutsOnboarding.jsx: agreement checkbox gates the connect button correctly and the 5%/AED derived from /status are rendered accurately.
AdminPlatformFees.jsx: percent input accepts decimals but sends bps; verified round-trip 15→14→15 persists. Consider client-side validation for 0..50 (matches server 0..5000 bps).
